purpose: Expose machine-readable precondition faults for agent-facing control operations without replacing existing Result<T,String> surfaces or introducing a new execution authority.

authority.operation_semantics: existing AgentWorkspace, AgentGraphBuilder, LayerRegistry, workspace_ops, and Burn boundaries remain authoritative
authority.resolution_boundary: semantic ambiguity belongs to ResolutionDiagnostic; AgentFault may rejoin only as typed observation through ResolutionEvidenceInbox

fault_classes.control_integrity: workspace metadata invariant is unexpectedly missing or corrupted
fault_classes.semantic_precondition: known semantic/layout incompatibility is detected before mutation
fault_classes.registry_precondition: LayerRegistry does not satisfy the graph/spec binding requirement
fault_classes.compile_precondition: graph/output state cannot be compiled as requested

codes.E_NO_FREE_SLOT: no free workspace slot is available
codes.E_RESERVE_SLOT_REJECTED: reserveSlot failed a remaining canonical validation
codes.E_SLOT_OUT_OF_RANGE: slot is outside the relevant control domain
codes.E_SLOT_TRANSITION: requested slot lifecycle transition is invalid
codes.E_SLOT_NOT_FOUND: expected workspace slot metadata is missing
codes.E_SLOT_NOT_READABLE: slot state is neither input nor reserved
codes.E_CONTROL_DOMAIN_MISMATCH: workspace and graph builder disagree on num_slots
codes.E_SPEC_ARITY: unary/binary spec does not match the requested operation
codes.E_LAYOUT_PREFLIGHT: known incompatible layout or invalid layout provenance rejected the edge
codes.E_LAYER_ALREADY_EXISTS: new-layer init requested for an already initialized registry identity
codes.E_LAYER_NOT_RESERVED: workspace layer identity was not reserved before canonical initialization
codes.E_LABEL_LIMIT: operation label exceeds the canonical helper limit
codes.E_INPUT_PRECONDITION: input slot failed a canonical fallback validation
codes.E_OUTPUT_NOT_WRITTEN: compile output slot was not written by any graph step
codes.E_REGISTRY_BINDING: compiled graph references one or more absent registry layers
codes.E_COMPILE_REJECTED: remaining non-mutating compile validation rejected the graph

interactionCheckReserveSlot.checks: reserveSlot preconditions against a clone of AgentWorkspace

interactionCheckInitUnary.checks: canonical unary initialization preconditions including layout preflight

interactionCheckInitBinary.checks: canonical binary initialization preconditions including layout preflight

interactionCheckCompile.checks: output written state, registry completeness, and non-mutating workspaceCompile

invariants: preflight calls do not mutate caller-owned workspace, builder, or registry
fault codes are selected by explicit predicate checks rather than legacy error-string parsing
legacy operation error messages remain unchanged
a successful preflight does not replace authoritative validation at the actual operation boundary

runtime_resolution_rejoin.policy: structured AgentFault fields may be transported as agent_fault_preflight evidence, but remain distinct from ResolutionDiagnostic and never create one automatically
runtime_resolution_rejoin.authority: source_authority=agent_fault_preflight with evidence_authority=observation_only and transport_integrity=host_structured_unverified; not numerical proof and not ResolutionDiagnostic authority
runtime_resolution_rejoin.authentication: ResolutionEvidenceInbox does not independently authenticate host-transported fault fields; structured runtime surface remains the original source.
